dedupe_keys.name: velocity spectra and coherence estimates in the marine atmospheric boundary layer

description: Cheynet, Etienne and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The formulation combines pointed and blunt marine atmospheric spectra with stability dependence and evaluates Davenport and two-parameter coherence representations. FINO1 measurements from 2007–2008 provide the stated offshore evidence. These representations support estimation of wind loading and correlated inflow for marine wind-energy structures. Agreement within this campaign does not establish accuracy at all heights, stability regimes or offshore sites. The record describes the model formulation; openly distributed executable code is not established. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
